contract.kind: expert-mask region of interest (information condition: a manual lesion mask is required at application time)
contract.information_condition: The crop is derived from an expert lesion mask. Applying the ROI branch later needs a manual mask, so its classification performance must not be reported as a pure image-to-score pipeline. Only a separate segmentation branch could create the crop without an expert mask. The full-image branch and its results stay valid and unchanged.
contract.mask_meaning: The mask annotates the lesion (benign lesions have masks as well). It is neither a cancer label nor a marker of histologically healthy background.

mask_encoding.conversion: True -> 1 = annotated lesion, False -> 0 = background; any other encoding, intermediate value, empty mask or size mismatch is an error (no threshold, no repair)
mask_encoding.foreground_direction_rule: True is the lesion iff the median True share over the training masks is below one half (the typical mask covers a small part of the image); masks above one half are reported as findings, not repaired
mask_encoding.foreground_direction_evidence: recorded in the status of the analysis (True share of every training mask, masks above one half listed as findings)

contract.coordinates: original pixel coordinates of the decoded image, half-open [x0, x1) x [y0, y1), w = x1 - x0, h = y1 - y0
contract.box: axis-parallel box around ALL positive mask pixels; with several components every component is included; empty mask = abort, no substitute box

components.use: descriptive only; the box always includes all components

expansion.fraction: 1/5 (20 %) of the box width on the left and right and of the box height at the top and bottom
expansion.order: 1) tight box from all positive pixels, 2) expand in exact rational arithmetic, 3) clip to [0, W] x [0, H]
expansion.rounding: left = floor(x0 - w/5), right = ceil(x1 + w/5), top = floor(y0 - h/5), bottom = ceil(y1 + h/5); equal to a margin of ceil(w/5) resp. ceil(h/5) pixels on both sides
expansion.border_contact: a side that touches or would pass the image border stops at the border (no mirroring, no padding with invented pixels); the cut-off is recorded

contract.crop: the UNMASKED original image inside the expanded box (plain crop)

preparation.rule: existing aspect-ratio preserving rule of busbra.image_processing.resize_with_padding (whole crop fitted into the square, bilinear, centred on black)
preparation.note: Pillow's ImageOps.contain also enlarges crops that are smaller than 160 pixels; the scale factor is reported per image

not_used: blackening or masking outside the lesion
BBOX or BI-RADS metadata as model input
ground-truth masks of validation or test data in this step
contract.fixed_choices: The 20 % margin is a fixed experimental choice. It was not optimised on validation data, is not a millimetre value and is not claimed to be optimal.
preview_selection_rule: Only training pairs are candidates (split == train); validation and test pairs are never candidates.

Part 1: for every combination (device in alphabetical order, class benign then malignant) the image whose positive-pixel fraction is closest to the median fraction of that group; ties go to the smallest ID.

Part 2, extremes (each takes the best candidate that is not selected yet; ties go to the smallest ID): smallest number of positive pixels; largest positive-pixel fraction; most connected components (only if more than one); touching the most image borders with the tight box (only if at least one); largest number of pixels cut off by the image border from the expanded box (only if above zero).
No selection by visual impression, by model output or by validation/test information.
geometry_checks: all positive mask pixels lie inside the tight box
the expanded box contains the tight box and lies inside the image
each margin equals min(ceil(edge/5), distance to the image border)
all positive mask pixels lie inside the crop
crop size equals expanded box size

note: Frozen before any validation or test mask is used for anything. A later change is only possible as a new contract version with a documented reason; this file is never rewritten and a differing rule stops the analysis.
